name: IncarnaMind
description: An AI editor. Every AI content shows the page it came from and highlights the quote. Free, open-source desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux: check your own drafts against your documents, take meeting notes on your computer. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Ollama. A NotebookLM alternative.
